# Meemaw - French Dictation & Spelling App (iOS)

Meemaw is an iOS educational application designed to make learning French spelling, grammar, and conjugation fun, positive, and stress-free for kids, families, and French language learners (FLE).

## Core Philosophy
- Positive reinforcement instead of red-ink school punishment.
- Vibrant Neo-Brutalist & Pop-Art comic aesthetic.
- 100% on-device local speech processing (no privacy invasion, works fully offline).
- Apple Family Sharing: 1 single purchase or subscription for up to 6 family members.

## 5 Progression Levels (Niveaux de Progression)
- Niveau 1 : Apprenti — Spelling basics, regular sounds, and simple everyday words.
- Niveau 2 : Initié — Basic gender and number agreements, plurals, and common homophones (a/à, et/est).
- Niveau 3 : Confirmé — Regular conjugations, key narrative tenses, and inverted subject-verb agreements.
- Niveau 4 : Expert — Subtleties of the language, past participle agreements with avoir, and tricky homophones (leur/leurs).
- Niveau 5 : Maître — Advanced spelling, complex pronominal past participles, and complete French language mastery.

## Key Features & Voice Mechanics
- Step-by-step Dictation: Meemaw reads the full sentence first for global understanding, then dictates word by word.
- On-Demand Replay & Speed: Replay buttons to listen again as needed, with 3 selectable speech speeds (Normal 1x, Slow 0.5x, Very Slow 0.25x).
- 6 Grammar Themes (L'Astuce de Meemaw): Agreements, Homophones, Conjugations, Plurals, Everyday Spelling, and Expressions with explicit good examples vs common traps.
- Kids vs Parents Duels (Duels Enfants vs Parents): Challenge parents or friends on the same dictation via WhatsApp or SMS with instant score comparison.
- Gamification & Meemaw Coins 🪙: Earn gold coins on flawless sessions, unlock collectible trophies, and climb the Game Center global leaderboard.

## 8 Distinct Game Modes
1. Dictée Rapide (Quick Dictation - 5 phrases, score out of 20)
2. Dictée Longue (Full Dictation - sentence then word by word)
3. Marathon 20/20 (Continue until flawless)
4. QCM Express (Rapid-fire grammar quiz)
5. Mot à Mot (Single word spelling)
6. Dictée Folle ! (Find and correct Grandma's intentional mistakes)
7. Détective (Mystery words and spelling riddles)
8. Anagrammes (Unscramble letters into target words)

## Availability & Downloads
- Platform: iOS (iPhone & iPad)
- App Store URL: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757681331
